slides.title: The wrong brief buys [the wrong fix].
slides.lede: Positioning, strategy or execution: work out which one is broken before you commission anything.

slides.title: Positioning is [one choice]. Strategy carries it through.

cards.label: Brand positioning
cards.text: Why a specific buyer should choose you over the alternatives.

cards.label: Brand strategy
cards.text: Connects that choice to identity, messaging, experience and decisions.

items.title: No clear reason to choose
items.text: Positioning-led work. Not a logo redesign first.

items.title: Clients get it, the website doesn't
items.text: A messaging correction. Don't reopen the position.

items.title: Delivery contradicts the promise
items.text: Fix delivery before advertising the promise louder.

slides.text: Possibly. But if each partner wants a different audience or promise, the copywriter is being asked to settle a leadership decision.

slides.title: Decisions you can use [in a proposal]
slides.note: Judge it by **whether it works in a client conversation**, not by workshop count or deck length.

slides.title: Put your proposal [beside a competitor's]
slides.text: Mark the reason to choose, the evidence behind it and the promise delivery must keep. Missing answers are questions to investigate, not proof you need a rebrand.

slides.title: Commission the missing decision, not another deck.
